items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I played with John about three years too. >> [INTERVIEWEE] Did you work for Billy Phillips? Did you work for Billy Phillips? Just one or two nights like that, you know.

ctx.x: He said, did you ever hang around, what is it? Play around Franklin and Iberville. Did you ever play music around Franklin and Iberville? Franklin and Iberville?

Iberville. Oh yeah, yeah. John 25, there was a place around there, Pete Lally, Howard Parker, Billy, you know, all of them, but the district was open. And then that's the district closed where everything was like, but I used to play around in the French Quarter, you know, that part in the doghouse. You know what I'm talking about? I didn't know if they were up yet.
The doghouse is gone, but I remember it. Yeah.
